name: modern
description: Bold Montserrat-900 design with electric blue accent on off-white; navy feature bands, soft-shadow white cards, rounded buttons. Built from the pushpress-site-modern.webflow.io reference in a Template Studio session.

hero.description: Full-bleed photo hero with left dark gradient, uppercase kicker band, 49px white 900 headline, right-aligned play-arrow CTA.
hero.usage:
First section of home and landing pages. Heading supports
for line control; keep it under ~8 words. Needs a high-quality dark-toned photo.

program-cards.description: Alternating text/image rows; 38px 900 program names, rounded photography, blue CTA per program.
program-cards.usage: Home (2-3 flagship programs) and programs-index (all). Give each program a real photo; rows alternate automatically.

coach-grid.description: White cards with 4:5 portrait, name, blue uppercase role, bio, certification chips.
coach-grid.usage: Coaches page lead section; also works on about. 3 columns; portraits should be consistent crops.

schedule.description: Per-day white cards with blue day labels and time/name slots.
schedule.usage: Schedule page. Feed real class times; empty days show a rest-day note.

testimonials.description: Italic 900 centered heading, white review cards with gold stars, avatar initial, name and source.
testimonials.usage: Home social-proof slot and testimonials page. 3 reviews per row; quotes 2-4 sentences.

faq.description: Accordion with soft-shadow cards; first item open; emits FAQPage JSON-LD for AEO.
faq.usage: Home (4-6 questions) and any page needing objection-handling. Answers are plain text.

cta-band.description: Navy band, 44px 900 white heading, blue play-arrow button, optional right-side photo blended with gradient.
cta-band.usage: Page-closing conversion slot on nearly every page. Without an image it centers.

location-map.description: Split layout: heading, bold address, hours, phone, directions button; map iframe or styled address panel.
location-map.usage: Home lower section and location-contact page. Supply mapEmbedUrl when available.

contact-form.description: Soft-shadow card form with default name/email/phone/message fields, POSTs to the Milo leads endpoint.
contact-form.usage: Contact/about pages. Use lead-form instead for conversion-focused funnels.

lead-form.description: Navy split section: heading + supporting copy left, white form card right; formId routes the lead.
lead-form.usage: getting-started and landing pages — the primary conversion component. Keep fields minimal (3-5).

pricing.description: White plan cards with 52px 900 prices, feature checklists; featured plan raised with blue border and badge.
pricing.usage: Pricing page. 2-4 plans; mark exactly one featured.

feature-grid.description: Card grid of title+body items with icons or numbers.

variants.default: white cards with blue line icons
variants.numbered: blue 900 numerals — for real sequences (getting-started steps)
variants.cards: raised trio overlapping the section above — place directly after hero

feature-grid.usage: The workhorse. Pick the variant by intent: cards after hero, numbered for how-it-works, dark for amenities/features band.

content-block.description: Measured prose section: 44px 900 heading + 18px paragraphs split on blank lines.
content-block.usage: About/pillar pages for narrative content. Keep to ~3 paragraphs per block; stack blocks for longer stories.

media-block.description: Heading + copy beside a white-framed photo with soft shadow; mediaSide controls order.
media-block.usage: Community/story sections. Pairs well after testimonials on home.

stats-band.description: Navy full-width band with 56px 900 white values over blue uppercase labels.
stats-band.usage: Credibility punch between sections; 3-4 stats, short labels.

logo-strip.description: Muted uppercase heading over a centered row of grayscale logos.

home.notes: The canonical composition mirrors the reference site's narrative arc: hook → reassure → offer → how → proof → facilities → community → find-us → objections → convert.

about.notes: Narrative first, credibility, community photo, low-pressure contact.

getting-started.notes: Single-purpose conversion page; do not dilute with extra sections.
